scope: Complete path inventory of fetch/api at the inherited Fetch WPT pin, with non-browser HTTP candidate selection and exact known exclusions. Preparation only; no WPT fixture is imported or executed by this change.

pinAuthority.note: Shared table is currently owned by open #47. Match its directory revisions and register every imported file there only in the later execution PR; this preparation does not edit it.

undiciCompatibilityContext.interpretation: Recorded Undici outcomes are compatibility context, not an applicability allowlist and not nts measurements. Failed applicable cases remain candidates. The status file uses generated .any.html/.window.html paths; mapping preserves query variants. A missing entry is not a pass or exclusion.

selectionRules: Wait for #27 and #45 to land, then branch execution work from current main; do not edit src/fetch while they are open.
Use canonical package classes and real provider HTTP operations, with one outer run hang bound. No timer decides a test result.
Import upstream files unchanged with existing headers and BSD-3-Clause license; register file SHA-256 and Git blob ID in the single versions table. Reuse existing copies and shared helpers.
Keep exact browser-profile/reflection/timing exclusions separate from unimplemented source behavior and resource capability gaps.
Observe genuine response completion and cancellation. Do not synthesize Fetch success, proxy Node Fetch as the implementation, or turn resource failure into a rejection-test pass.

Names containing concrete fixture URLs in this preparation are templates captured with web-platform.test:8000/8001 and :8443. Match final actual-origin names after server allocation; all other names are exact upstream registration strings.
No pass/fail count in undiciContext describes nts; execution is deferred. File counts below describe inventory paths only.
